_comment: CHANGE TOGETHER: one contract, a copy in each repo, byte for byte: agent tests/fixtures/server_cards.json (read by tests/test_proactive_cards.py) and prism apps/server/test/fixtures/omni-card-validation.json (checked by omni-card-validation-fixture.test.ts against the real parseCardInput). Shared fixture. Each case is a card as the agent hands it over (before sourceKey/itemRefs are added) and whether the SERVER accepts it. Mirrors parseCardInput in apps/server/src/omni/cards.ts (with plainInline/looksLikeSlug in omni/titles.ts, validatePayload in omni/approvals.ts, rsvpArgs in actions/calendar.ts). The publisher sends sourceKey and itemRefs = [event.id]; event.id here is mail1. Regenerate the verdicts by running the server function; do not edit them by hand. A case with agentTruncates is one the server rejects but the agent repairs (keeps four facts, or cuts a long fact to 200 characters) before publishing.
